angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 598,302 km at 151.18 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.6148 +/- 0.0115 mas (same row, RUWE 0.90): 151.18 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.86 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Anderson et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-91 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...604A.110A/abstract): 598,302 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.84 +/- 0.07 solar masses from Anderson et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-91 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...604A.110A/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4920 +/- 80 K from Anderson et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-91 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...604A.110A/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Anderson et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-91 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...604A.110A/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-91.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.493, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-91 (pscomppars): spectral type K3, from Anderson et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...604A.110A/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, WASP-91: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-91 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.19 dex, from Anderson et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...604A.110A/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-91 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.3827, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-91 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.4 km/s, from Anderson et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...604A.110A/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
